name: vestaloop_list_events
description: List calendar events in the household (home), newest first. Optional `from` and `to` bounds (UTC ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-07-28T00:00:00Z) restrict the time window; omit both to list everything. Each event has: id (UUID), title, description, location, starts_at, ends_at, all_day, scope ('personal'|'shared'), source ('portal'|'google'), status. Use this to discover an event's `id` before vestaloop_get_event / vestaloop_update_event / vestaloop_delete_event.

from.description: Optional lower bound on the time window, UTC ISO-8601. Omit for no lower bound.

to.description: Optional upper bound on the time window, UTC ISO-8601. Omit for no upper bound.
